Package dev.px.core.hud

Class Bounds

java.lang.Object
dev.px.core.hud.Bounds
public final class Bounds extends Object
An immutable axis-aligned rectangle in scaled screen space.

The HUD's 2D counterpart to Box, which is world-space and three-dimensional. They are kept apart on purpose: a screen rectangle and a world box share no operations worth unifying, and one type doing both would invite passing the wrong one.

This is the layout geometry: where an element sits and how much room it occupies. What it actually draws, and where it responds to clicks, are the element's Shape and need not match.
